chart.title:
Natureza R/D
Total:$QTDTOTAL
Realizado:$QTDATUAL
chart.expression: SELECT P.NUMERO AS QTDTOTAL, Q.QTD AS QTDATUAL, ROUND(CASE WHEN Q.QTD IS NULL OR Q.QTD = 0 THEN 0 ELSE Q.QTD * 100 / CASE WHEN P.NUMERO IS NULL OR P.NUMERO = 0 THEN Q.QTD ELSE P.NUMERO END END,0) AS PERCCOMPL FROM AD_PARAM P, (SELECT COUNT(1) AS QTD FROM TGFNAT WHERE CODNAT <> 0 AND ANALITICA = 'S') Q WHERE P.CHAVE = 'QTDNAT'
